title: Chat.receiptSharing missing semantics for true vs false
description: Location: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md, Chat object fields, lines 441-442. Issue: The Chat.receiptSharing field description explains the precedence rule (per-chat overrides account-level) but does not state what true or false mean at this level. A reader must cross-reference PresenceStatus.receiptSharing to learn that false means read receipts are not sent. Suggested fix: add one sentence, e.g., 'A value of false suppresses outbound Peer/receipt readAt calls for this Chat; see PresenceStatus.receiptSharing for the account-level definition of these semantics.'
close_reason: Opinion: Chat.receiptSharing cross-references presence-status; one-hop lookup is acceptable
